purpose: Define explicit canonical and runtime addressing semantics so roots, paths, namespace separators and property addresses resolve deterministically without path traversal or dynamic root selection.

owns: Core Addressing and Namespace Resolution semantics

topics.name: Addressing
topics.purpose: Define explicit canonical and runtime addressing semantics so roots, paths, namespace separators and property addresses resolve deterministically without path traversal or dynamic root selection.

semantics.root_rule: Address roots are explicit registered semantic roots.
semantics.segment_rule: Address segments follow the owning grammar and are not arbitrary filesystem path fragments.
semantics.dynamic_root_rule: Payload-selected or response-selected dynamic root authority is forbidden.
semantics.property_rule: Property addressing remains typed and is not collapsed into generic hierarchy.
semantics.filesystem_rule: Canonical/runtime addresses are semantic addresses, not direct filesystem paths.
semantics.resolution_rule: Address resolution preserves root ownership and namespace semantics.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant semantics are explicit and deterministic.

hard_gates.condition: dynamic root selection from payload/model/backend output
path traversal or symlink semantics enter canonical addressing
property address collapsed into untyped generic hierarchy
semantic address treated as unrestricted filesystem path

references.purpose: Canonical identities and namespace targets resolve deterministically.
